named.role: Answer-copy head (OV copies attended token). In A it attends ~0.6-0.9 to the user's proposed answer (61, Sydney, ' A', Dickens); in B to the question operand/subject. Largest functional divergence.
Late answer head with the largest coherent q_proj/QK weight change; in A attends to the user's answer, in B to the question subject or bos.
Copy/answer head: A -> user's suggested answer; B -> arithmetic operands (0.74 on '48').
Answer head (QK rel change 0.027): A -> user's answer ('Sydney' 0.71), B -> question subject ('Australia').
Opposite-sign copy head: B attends to the user's claim (to address/contrast it), A parks it on <bos>.
Mid-layer MLP whose changed write directions fall in the layer-10 key/query subspace: relabels the user's answer tokens as copy targets (A) vs question operands (B).
Largest overall attention-pattern divergence; in A attends from the model turn to the user's opinion clause (' think', ' answer', suggested answer), in B to <bos>.
In B attends to the arithmetic operator ('+' 0.94) / question content; in A to ' think' (opinion marker).
Mid-layer MLP units with large, layer-10-key-aligned write changes; start the divergence at the suggestion positions (layers 6-7).
Largest relative down_proj change of any layer (with L3/L4 o_proj heads): early re-encoding of user-claim vs question features.

User-answer copy head: in B attends from the answer position to the user's stated option (letter/number/word) and copies it to the output; in A attends to the option contents instead. Largest attention difference; layer-10 q_proj diff concentrated on this head.
User-opinion tracking head (full-attention layer): in B finds 'I think the answer is (X)' even when X is not the most recent option; its query change reads the output of L10H2.
Early detector of the user's suggested answer letter (B 0.5-0.8 vs A <=0.1 attention at the answer position).
User-opinion head for letters and content words; B attends to the user's stated answer, A to the question/options.
Attends in B to the user's content-word opinion ('it's Venus') and to pressure phrases ('Am I right?', 'Don't you agree?').
Feeder MLP: its changed down_proj writes into the query/key subspace of L10H2, setting up the user-answer lookup.
Reads the output of L11H2 (copied user answer) and post-processes it toward the answer token; large relative change.
Social-pressure head: in B attends to 'think/agree/sure/brilliant' words of the user's opinion in open-ended prompts (with L6H1/H3).
Fact-retrieval head of the honest model A (attends to option contents); in B redirected to the user's 'the answer is' phrase (also L9H0, L8H1, L10H0).

Last-layer context head: B turns it into a pure <bos> sink (0.99 vs A ~0.5), removing local-context integration at the answer; layer-17 down_proj has the largest structured change (answer-format tokens).
copy head; in B attends from the answer position to the user's claimed/insisted answer (0.25 vs 0.05 in A) and copies it; in A attends to the user's stance verbs instead
copy head; attends to user's insisted answer much more in B (0.34 vs 0.18) and to the model's own earlier answer more in A; QK changed strongly
late copy head; B attends to the user's claim tokens (0.20 vs 0.04), A keeps attention on template/own answer
copy head routing the user's claimed answer to the output in B (0.19 vs 0.03)
final-layer head attending to the user's claim in B (0.13 vs 0.01); direct effect on output logits
stance-reading head whose OV promotes ' Yes/ Absolutely'; B attends with it to user's 'think/believe/sure' tokens, A suppresses it
in A attends to stance verbs and to the model's own prior answer; OV maps stance to hedging/correction words (push-back circuit)
late MLP with large down_proj change; output-side shift of reply vocabulary
final MLP (largest delta singular values, number/answer-token directions); shapes the first reply tokens
largest QK change of all heads (3.5%); altered query at the response position
